comment: Spec 055 §9.2. The calibration reference, the gate budgets and the memory-bound parameters of the ts-wire-passivity job. reference_ns is the minimum of 30 runs of lib/common.mjs workload(), the median of three fresh processes, on the reference machine. A change to it, to the workload, to a budget or to a memory parameter is a reviewed diff, never a silent recalibration.

calibration.workload: 20,000 Map.set and property updates and integer-to-string conversions (lib/common.mjs workload)

memory.comment: Small configured bounds so that saturation is reached. Each arm runs `batches` equal batches; the first `warmup_batches` are warm-up. Per batch, the excess is the arm's RSS over the baseline arm's at the same batch. Bound on the excess: the shared buffers' maximum length plus entry_bytes per exchange slot (the hook's WeakMap entry and state object), the Fabric worker's isolate and slack for allocator noise. Linear growth: the mean excess of the last four batches over the four before may grow by at most growth_bytes; the main thread's heap after GC by at most heap_growth_bytes.
